correctness.rationale: Explicit recursion reduces rank three to exhaustive pair/singleton Boolean conditions. The two required same-shore rank-one pairs force at least four vertices per shore and five edges globally. Every one of 2^16 four-by-four matrices has been checked with both the derived predicate and independent direct recursion; the exact 9,672 count agrees. Side-preserving canonical orbit enumeration yields 29 classes, independently checked by Burnside with fixed sum 16,704. The unique five-edge orbit of 576 labelled matrices is represented by P6 with one isolate on each shore.
